topic: Lidar sensor procurement and technical requirements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on procuring a Lidar scanner (specifically the RPLIDAR S1) and related hardware. A link to the sensor was shared, prompting questions about its pricing.

Regarding technical requirements for data collection from the sensor, specific questions were raised concerning:
*   How the collected data will be stored and transferred (e.g., via cloud).
*   Any technical requirements mandated by the airport or DDF.

Additionally, hardware needed includes a case for the Jetson board, MicroSD card, and power supply.
decisions: A direct contact with Slamtech should be sought to negotiate better pricing on the Lidar sensor.
action_items: [p3] will send a contact after the meeting.
Investigate alternative sources for Jetson and associated hardware (case, power supply).
